GERMANY AEROSPACE FOR TELANGANA - THE 2000-PAGE REFERENCE BOOK (ENGLISH)

From Intermediate (TSBIE, no JEE) to an Aerospace degree: every college, fee, tax, APS step, Kolleg exam, visa queue and job rule

Compiled 2026-09-17 from CYCLES 1-4 (about 550 research queries + live fetches: aps-india.de, daad.in, stk.kit.edu, tk.de, india.diplo.de, testas.de, testdaf.de, hyderabad.german.in).
Rule: no predictions. [UNVERIFIED] = verify on the official page/memo before paying or booking. Search API was rate-limited in C2-C4, fallback was direct fetch.
Print: A4, 2000 pages (CSS @page). Web: search + table of contents + chapters.

How to use this book: Pages 1-80: foundations + roadmaps. Pages 81-1690: 35 programs x about 46 pages each (overview, curriculum, admission, fees, deadlines, checklists, SOP draft, visa, jobs, FAQs, worksheets). Pages 1691-1900: Telangana no-JEE playbook (TSBIE, German in Hyderabad, Kolleg/FSP, B.Tech bridge). Pages 1901-2000: money/tax/visa/scholarships/PR + appendix (tables, links, glossary).

Contents

  • Part I: System + roadmap without JEE (pp. 7-80)
  • Part II: 35 programs (pp. 81-1690)
  • Part III: Telangana playbook (pp. 1691-1900)
  • Part IV: Money/tax/visa/jobs/PR + appendix (pp. 1901-2000)

Page 7 - Foundations: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Worksheet p.7: Fill in your values (TSBIE % = (Y1+Y2)/1000; German hours per week; IELTS target; 6-8 dream unis on myguide.de). Tick off: passport matches memo spelling [ ] | APS quiz done [ ] | Goethe A1 booked [ ] | TestAS date [ ] | VPD plan 6-8 weeks before deadline [ ] | Blocked provider chosen (Expatrio/Fintiba, NOT Coracle) [ ].

Page 8 - Foundations: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Page 9 - Foundations: German + TestAS + IELTS in Hyderabad

Goethe-Zentrum Hyderabad, Banjara Hills (20 Journalists Colony Rd 3): Rs 27,730 per level for A1/A2/B1, B2 split in two parts, C1 via the office. Exams: A1 9400 / A2 10600 / B1 18800 / B2 21200 / C1 24000. TestDaF EUR 195 (no fixed Hyderabad slot, travel to Chennai/Bengaluru/Delhi/Pune). telc exams via German Drishty Hyderabad. A degree needs C1 (TestDaF 4x4 / DSH-2 / Goethe C1 / telc C1 Hochschule). Kolleg application needs B1 on paper, realistically B2. TestAS Core + Engineering module (24.10.26 / 26.11.26 / 25.02.27), target score 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH). IELTS at IDP Begumpet/Kukatpally Rs 17k/19k, centre-based only; Duolingo, PTE, Home Edition and MOI letters are rejected for the visa (india.diplo.de).

Page 10 - Foundations: Blocked account + semester fee + living + health

Blocked account 2026: 11,904 per year = 992 per month (+100-150 buffer = 12,050). Expatrio 119 + 9/month, Fintiba 159 + 9.90/month, Coracle is DEAD (paused Aug 25), Deutsche Bank is slow. Semester contribution 70-430 (TUM 97, Stuttgart 184 + 1500 tuition, Berlin 379.06, Braunschweig 440, HAW 397). TUM non-EU tuition 2000/3000 Bachelor + 4000/6000 Master; Baden-Wuerttemberg 1500; second degree 650; long-term Lower Saxony 500. Living: Munich 1200-1500 (WG 600-800), Stuttgart 1000-1300, Berlin 1000-1300, Hamburg 950-1250, Aachen 850-1000, Bremen 850-1050. Health insurance TK: 141.16 (under 23 / with child) / 146.29 (23+ childless) = 110.38 base incl. 2.69% + 30.78/35.91 care. Deutschland ticket 63/month from 01.01.26, semester ticket 208-226, broadcast fee 18.36 per flat.

Page 11 - Foundations: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Werkstudent rule: max 20 hours per week during lectures, unlimited in holidays inside the 140-day cap, max 26 weeks / 182 days over 20 hours per 12 months, pension-only contributions, free health/care/unemployment insurance. Tax class I if single, VI for a second job (highest). Basic allowance 12,096/24,192 rising to 12,348/24,696. Income tax 14-45% via payroll, refund by filing (4 years retroactive). Solidarity surcharge 5.5% with allowance 19,950/39,900 rising to 20,350/40,700. Minimum wage 13.90 (2026) rising to 14.60 (2027).

Page 12 - Foundations: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

Tick off: passport matches memo spelling [ ] | APS quiz done [ ] | Goethe A1 booked [ ] | TestAS date [ ] | VPD plan 6-8 weeks before deadline [ ] | Blocked provider chosen (Expatrio/Fintiba, NOT Coracle) [ ].

Page 13 - Foundations: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Page 14 - Foundations: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Page 23 - Foundations: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

Page 24 - Foundations: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Page 27 - Foundations: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Page 28 - Foundations: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

Page 29 - Foundations: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Page 43 - Foundations: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Page 44 - Foundations: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

Page 45 - Foundations: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Page 46 - Foundations: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Page 47 - Foundations: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Page 48 - Foundations: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Page 62 - Foundations: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Page 63 - Foundations: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Page 64 - Foundations: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Page 67 - Foundations: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Werkstudent rule: max 20 hours per week during lectures, unlimited in holidays inside the 140-day cap, max 26 weeks / 182 days over 20 hours per 12 months, pension-only contributions, free health/care/unemployment insurance. Tax class I if single, VI for a second job (highest). Basic allowance 12,096/24,192 rising to 12,348/24,696. Income tax 14-45% via payroll, refund by filing (4 years retroactive). Solidarity surcharge 5.5% with allowance 19,950/39,900 rising to 20,350/40,700. Minimum wage 13.90 (2026) rising to 14.60 (2027).

Page 68 - Foundations: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.82 TUM Aerospace B.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.83 TUM Aerospace B.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Aptitude test (EFV), no NC, 8-week internship. Deadline: Winter only 15.05-15.07 (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.100 TUM Aerospace B.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Chapter 2: TUM Aerospace M.Sc.

TU Munich, Garching, Bavaria | M.Sc. 120 ECTS, 4 sem | Language: German/English (full-English track possible, 70% EN) | Cost: 6000/sem + 97 | Deadline: Winter 01.04-31.05, Summer 01.09-30.11 | Admission: Aptitude test (EV), IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 88

Official page: https://www.ed.tum.de/en/ed/studies/degree-programs/aerospace-m-sc

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.128 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.129 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Aptitude test (EV), IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 88. Deadline: Winter 01.04-31.05, Summer 01.09-30.11 (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.130 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Money + city

6000/sem + 97. Contribution types: TUM 97 / Stuttgart 184 / Berlin 379.06 WS26/27 / Braunschweig 440 / Hamburg 384 / HAW 397 / Bremen about 380-425. Baden-Wuerttemberg tuition 1500/sem (Stuttgart/KIT/HKA). Blocked account 11,904/year (992/month) + buffer to 12,050. Living: Munich 1200-1500, Stuttgart 1000-1300, Berlin 1000-1300, Hamburg 950-1250, Aachen 850-1000, Bremen 850-1050. Health insurance TK 141.16/146.29. Deutschland ticket 63/month, semester ticket 208-226, broadcast fee 18.36. Minijob 603 (13.90/h), Werkstudent 20 hours = 2.5 days, 140/280-day cap. Blue Card 2026: 50,700 / 45,934 - every aero salary clears it from day one (entry 48-75k: Airbus 58-68k, MTU/Rolls 60-72k, Lufthansa Technik 55-62k, DLR E13 52-60k).

p.131 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Deep dive: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.136 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.146 TUM Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 3: TUM ESPACE

TU Munich, Bavaria | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: 100% English, IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 88 | Cost: 6000/sem + 97 | Deadline: Winter only 01.01-31.05 | Admission: Essay 500-700 words + aptitude

Official page: https://www.ed.tum.de/en/ed/studies/degree-programs/earth-oriented-space-science-and-technology-m-sc

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.174 TUM ESPACE - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.175 TUM ESPACE - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Essay 500-700 words + aptitude. Deadline: Winter only 01.01-31.05 (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.176 TUM ESPACE - Money + city

6000/sem + 97. Contribution types: TUM 97 / Stuttgart 184 / Berlin 379.06 WS26/27 / Braunschweig 440 / Hamburg 384 / HAW 397 / Bremen about 380-425. Baden-Wuerttemberg tuition 1500/sem (Stuttgart/KIT/HKA). Blocked account 11,904/year (992/month) + buffer to 12,050. Living: Munich 1200-1500, Stuttgart 1000-1300, Berlin 1000-1300, Hamburg 950-1250, Aachen 850-1000, Bremen 850-1050. Health insurance TK 141.16/146.29. Deutschland ticket 63/month, semester ticket 208-226, broadcast fee 18.36. Minijob 603 (13.90/h), Werkstudent 20 hours = 2.5 days, 140/280-day cap. Blue Card 2026: 50,700 / 45,934 - every aero salary clears it from day one (entry 48-75k: Airbus 58-68k, MTU/Rolls 60-72k, Lufthansa Technik 55-62k, DLR E13 52-60k).

p.177 TUM ESPACE - Deep dive: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.180 TUM ESPACE - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Action for TUM ESPACE: Winter only 01.01-31.05. Portal: TUMonline. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.181 TUM ESPACE - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

p.182 TUM ESPACE - Practice: German + TestAS + IELTS in Hyderabad

Goethe-Zentrum Hyderabad, Banjara Hills (20 Journalists Colony Rd 3): Rs 27,730 per level for A1/A2/B1, B2 split in two parts, C1 via the office. Exams: A1 9400 / A2 10600 / B1 18800 / B2 21200 / C1 24000. TestDaF EUR 195 (no fixed Hyderabad slot, travel to Chennai/Bengaluru/Delhi/Pune). telc exams via German Drishty Hyderabad. A degree needs C1 (TestDaF 4x4 / DSH-2 / Goethe C1 / telc C1 Hochschule). Kolleg application needs B1 on paper, realistically B2. TestAS Core + Engineering module (24.10.26 / 26.11.26 / 25.02.27), target score 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH). IELTS at IDP Begumpet/Kukatpally Rs 17k/19k, centre-based only; Duolingo, PTE, Home Edition and MOI letters are rejected for the visa (india.diplo.de).

p.186 TUM ESPACE - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.192 TUM ESPACE - Practice: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Werkstudent rule: max 20 hours per week during lectures, unlimited in holidays inside the 140-day cap, max 26 weeks / 182 days over 20 hours per 12 months, pension-only contributions, free health/care/unemployment insurance. Tax class I if single, VI for a second job (highest). Basic allowance 12,096/24,192 rising to 12,348/24,696. Income tax 14-45% via payroll, refund by filing (4 years retroactive). Solidarity surcharge 5.5% with allowance 19,950/39,900 rising to 20,350/40,700. Minimum wage 13.90 (2026) rising to 14.60 (2027).

p.210 TUM ESPACE - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Chapter 4: TU Darmstadt Aerospace M.Sc.

Darmstadt, Hessen | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: English C1 | Cost: 0 + ~300 | Deadline: Winter+Summer 15.07/15.01 | Admission: 2-hour online exam, 7 topics

Official page: https://www.tu-darmstadt.de/studieren/studieninteressierte/studienangebot_studiengaenge/studiengang_277056.en.jsp

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.220 TU Darmstadt Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.221 TU Darmstadt Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. 2-hour online exam, 7 topics. Deadline: Winter+Summer 15.07/15.01 (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.229 TU Darmstadt Aerospace M.Sc. - Deep dive: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.238 TU Darmstadt Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Chapter 5: RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc.

Aachen, NRW | M.Sc. 90, 3 sem | Language: German C1 (+ some English) | Cost: 0 + ~315 | Deadline: Winter+Summer | Admission: 145 CP Mech background, GRE for non-EU, 20-week internship

Official page: https://www.rwth-aachen.de/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.266 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.267 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. 145 CP Mech background, GRE for non-EU, 20-week internship. Deadline: Winter+Summer (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.268 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Money + city

p.269 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Deep dive: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

p.272 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

p.273 RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Action for RWTH Aachen Aerospace M.Sc.: Winter+Summer. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Chapter 6: TU Berlin Aerospace M.Sc.

Berlin | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: German (many English modules) | Cost: 0 + ~321-379 | Deadline: Winter 31.08 Summer 28.02 | Admission: Open admission, subject fitness

Official page: https://www.tu.berlin/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.312 TU Berlin Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.313 TU Berlin Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). p.347 TU Berlin Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Chapter 7: TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing)

Berlin | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem hybrid | Language: English B2 + 1-year experience | Cost: 6225/sem (24,900 total) | Deadline: Winter 15.05 Summer 15.01 | Admission: Bachelor + work experience

Official page: https://mse.tu-berlin.de/

Without JEE: YES with English + 1 year experience (expensive). Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.358 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.359 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Bachelor + work experience. Deadline: Winter 15.05 Summer 15.01 (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.364 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Practice: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Werkstudent rule: max 20 hours per week during lectures, unlimited in holidays inside the 140-day cap, max 26 weeks / 182 days over 20 hours per 12 months, pension-only contributions, free health/care/unemployment insurance. Tax class I if single, VI for a second job (highest). Basic allowance 12,096/24,192 rising to 12,348/24,696. Income tax 14-45% via payroll, refund by filing (4 years retroactive). Solidarity surcharge 5.5% with allowance 19,950/39,900 rising to 20,350/40,700. Minimum wage 13.90 (2026) rising to 14.60 (2027).

Action for TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing): Winter 15.05 Summer 15.01. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.365 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Practice: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

Action for TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing): Winter 15.05 Summer 15.01. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.366 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Action for TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing): Winter 15.05 Summer 15.01. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.367 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Deep dive: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.390 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.391 TU Berlin MSE Space (continuing) - Deep dive: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 8: Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc.

Stuttgart-Vaihingen, BW | B.Sc. 180, 6 sem | Language: German | Cost: 1500 + 184 | Deadline: Winter 15.07, restricted | Admission: DoSV + pre-internship

Official page: https://www.uni-stuttgart.de/en/study/bachelor-programs/aerospace-engineering-b.sc./

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.404 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.405 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. DoSV + pre-internship. Deadline: Winter 15.07, restricted (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.409 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

p.410 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). p.411 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace B.Sc. - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 9: Uni Stuttgart Aerospace M.Sc.

Stuttgart, BW | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: German | Cost: 1500 + 184 | Deadline: Winter+Summer | Admission: Aptitude test

Official page: https://www.student.uni-stuttgart.de/studiengang/Luft--und-Raumfahrttechnik-M.Sc./

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.450 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.451 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Aptitude test. Deadline: Winter+Summer (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.468 Uni Stuttgart Aerospace M.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Chapter 10: TU Braunschweig Aerospace M.Sc.

Braunschweig, NI | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: German | Cost: 0 + ~375 | Deadline: Winter 30.06 Summer 15.01, open | Admission: Relevant Bachelor needed

Official page: https://www.tu-braunschweig.de/studienangebot/luft-und-raumfahrttechnik-master

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.496 TU Braunschweig Aerospace M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.497 TU Braunschweig Aerospace M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Relevant Bachelor needed. Deadline: Winter 30.06 Summer 15.01, open (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

Chapter 11: TU Dresden Diploma/M.Sc.

Dresden, SN | Diploma 10 sem / M.Sc. | Language: German | Cost: 0 + ~300 | Deadline: Winter | Admission: Via SINS portal

Official page: https://tu-dresden.de/ing/maschinenwesen/ilr/studium/studiengaenge

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.542 TU Dresden Diploma/M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.543 TU Dresden Diploma/M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Via SINS portal. Deadline: Winter (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.572 TU Dresden Diploma/M.Sc. - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). p.573 TU Dresden Diploma/M.Sc. - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 12: TUHH Aviation M.Sc.

Hamburg-Harburg | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: German (some English), B2.2 to C1 | Cost: 0 + ~332 | Deadline: Winter+Summer 15.07/15.01, open | Admission: BSc Mechanical

Official page: https://www.tuhh.de/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.588 TUHH Aviation M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.589 TUHH Aviation M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. BSc Mechanical. Deadline: Winter+Summer 15.07/15.01, open (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.596 TUHH Aviation M.Sc. - Practice: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

p.597 TUHH Aviation M.Sc. - Deep dive: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.606 TUHH Aviation M.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.
