Blue Card 2026: 50,700 / 45,934 - every aero salary clears it from day one (entry 48-75k: Airbus 58-68k, MTU/Rolls 60-72k, Lufthansa Technik 55-62k, DLR E13 52-60k).

p.1511 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Deep dive: Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

Minijob 556 (2025, at 12.82/h) rising to 603/month in 2026 (13.90/h x 130/3 = 7236/year). Midijob range 603.01-2000. Werkstudent rule: max 20 hours per week during lectures, unlimited in holidays inside the 140-day cap, max 26 weeks / 182 days over 20 hours per 12 months, pension-only contributions, free health/care/unemployment insurance. Tax class I if single, VI for a second job (highest). Basic allowance 12,096/24,192 rising to 12,348/24,696. Income tax 14-45% via payroll, refund by filing (4 years retroactive). Solidarity surcharge 5.5% with allowance 19,950/39,900 rising to 20,350/40,700. Minimum wage 13.90 (2026) rising to 14.60 (2027).

Apply it to JMU LRI B.Sc.: Wuerzburg, BY. Tick off for your application: HZB path (Kolleg or 1-year) [ ] | language certificate (C1/IELTS) [ ] | internship (6-22 weeks) [ ] | TestAS [ ] | VPD [ ] | SOP names 3-4 modules + lab/professor [ ].

p.1512 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Worksheet + FAQs

Checklist: memo percent [ ] | APS [ ] | B1/B2/C1 [ ] | IELTS [ ] | TestAS [ ] | VPD [ ] | SOP/CV/LOR [ ] | blocked [ ] | CSP/VFS [ ] | housing [ ] | Anmeldung [ ] | eAT [ ].

FAQs: Do I need JEE? No (Kolleg or 1-year bridge). Does EAMCET help? No. Is 68% enough? No (below 70% do a full B.Tech, then a Master). Telugu medium? Yes, plus IELTS and German. Gap year? Fine with certificates. English only? Only TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU (Masters) or TUM BSc + A2. UniBw? No (officers). ESA? Staff needs ESA citizenship (Indians via contractors/DLR). Lilium? Insolvent, do not rely on it.

p.1513 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Action for JMU LRI B.Sc.: Winter, open. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1514 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

Action for JMU LRI B.Sc.: Winter, open. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1515 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Action for JMU LRI B.Sc.: Winter, open. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1516 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Action for JMU LRI B.Sc.: Winter, open. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

TestAS Core + Engineering module (24.10.26 / 26.11.26 / 25.02.27), target score 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH). IELTS at IDP Begumpet/Kukatpally Rs 17k/19k, centre-based only; Duolingo, PTE, Home Edition and MOI letters are rejected for the visa (india.diplo.de).

p.1537 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1540 JMU LRI B.Sc. - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 33: JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec

Wuerzburg | M.Sc. 120, 4 sem | Language: English track B2 / SaTec English | Cost: 0 + ~150 | Deadline: Winter+Summer / Winter | Admission: Aptitude: 20 ECTS Maths

Official page: https://www.informatik.uni-wuerzburg.de/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.1554 JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.1555 JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Aptitude: 20 ECTS Maths. Deadline: Winter+Summer / Winter (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.1571 JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec - Practice: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

p.1572 JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Action for JMU Aerospace Info / SaTec: Winter+Summer / Winter. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

Chapter 34: Bremen Space Eng M.Sc.

Bremen | M.Sc. 90/120, 3-4 sem | Language: English C1 | Cost: 0 + ~380-425 | Deadline: Winter 30.04 Summer 15.10, 30 max | Admission: 24 CP aero + test + motivation

Official page: https://www.uni-bremen.de/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.1600 Bremen Space Eng M.Sc. - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.1601 Bremen Space Eng M.Sc. - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. 24 CP aero + test + motivation. Deadline: Winter 30.04 Summer 15.10, 30 max (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.1607 Bremen Space Eng M.Sc. - Practice: SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. p.1642 Bremen Space Eng M.Sc. - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Chapter 35: BTU Joint Fluids/Materials

Cottbus + Bordeaux + Louvain | M.Sc. 120 joint, 4 sem | Language: English IELTS 6.0 / TOEFL 79 | Cost: 0 + ~320 + mobility | Deadline: Winter: scholarship Jan, self Mar | Admission: Via consortium

Official page: https://www.b-tu.de/

Without JEE: YES via Kolleg or 1-year bridge. Anabin + APS + VPD are mandatory. German C1 except English tracks (TUM/Bremen/Darmstadt/FH Aachen/Wuerzburg/BTU).

p.1646 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Semester-by-semester curriculum

Semesters 1-2: foundations (higher mathematics, physics, technical mechanics, materials, thermodynamics, electrical engineering, programming). Semesters 3-4: fluid/gas dynamics, flight physics/aerodynamics, lightweight design/FEM, propulsion, flight mechanics/control, space systems. Semester 5: internship (HAW 22 weeks / HM 20 weeks in sem 5 / FH 8-week pre-internship + project / TU 6-20-week pre-internship) + electives (helicopter/aircraft/spacecraft/propulsion/simulation/CFD/aeroelasticity/avionics). Semesters 6-8: thesis 12-30 CP (6 months), best done in industry (Airbus/DLR/MTU). FH means small classes 40:1 and practice; TU means theory plus a direct PhD path. ECTS audit: maths 24+ + mechanics 18+ + fundamentals 12+ + aero modules (flight mechanics/aero/propulsion).

p.1647 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Admission without JEE (TSBIE)

Intermediate MPC 700+/1000 + APS XII procedure (Rs 18k, Delhi, 3-10 weeks, Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC) + VPD via uni-assist (4-6 weeks, valid 1 year, apply 6-8 weeks before the deadline) + language (German C1 TestDaF 4x4/DSH-2/Goethe C1/telc C1H, or English IELTS 6.5/TOEFL 88 depending on track) + TestAS Core + Engineering 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH) + possible pre-internship. Intermediate alone gives NO direct admission. Paths: T-Kurs + FSP, or 1-year B.Tech in Mechanical at an H+ university (JNTUH/OU/NIT), or JEE Advanced (subject-restricted to engineering). EAMCET / Mains alone: NO. Via consortium. Deadline: Winter: scholarship Jan, self Mar (start the VPD mid-May to mid-June for winter).

p.1651 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.1652 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Action for BTU Joint Fluids/Materials: Winter: scholarship Jan, self Mar. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1653 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). p.1676 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

Action for BTU Joint Fluids/Materials: Winter: scholarship Jan, self Mar. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1677 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Action for BTU Joint Fluids/Materials: Winter: scholarship Jan, self Mar. Portal: uni-assist or direct. Build a deadline calendar (VPD 6-8 weeks before, APS 4-6 months before, visa 6-8 weeks, arrival 1 week early).

p.1678 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Practice: German + TestAS + IELTS in Hyderabad

Goethe-Zentrum Hyderabad, Banjara Hills (20 Journalists Colony Rd 3): Rs 27,730 per level for A1/A2/B1, B2 split in two parts, C1 via the office. Exams: A1 9400 / A2 10600 / B1 18800 / B2 21200 / C1 24000. TestDaF EUR 195 (no fixed Hyderabad slot, travel to Chennai/Bengaluru/Delhi/Pune). telc exams via German Drishty Hyderabad. A degree needs C1 (TestDaF 4x4 / DSH-2 / Goethe C1 / telc C1 Hochschule). Kolleg application needs B1 on paper, realistically B2. TestAS Core + Engineering module (24.10.26 / 26.11.26 / 25.02.27), target score 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH). IELTS at IDP Begumpet/Kukatpally Rs 17k/19k, centre-based only; Duolingo, PTE, Home Edition and MOI letters are rejected for the visa (india.diplo.de).

p.1679 BTU Joint Fluids/Materials - Deep dive: VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1790 Telangana no-JEE playbook - SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1791 Telangana no-JEE playbook - Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). p.1901 Appendix - VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

Telangana / AP / TN / Puducherry belong to the Chennai mission (9 Boat Club Rd, RA Puram). VFS Hyderabad is at Punjagutta Metro. p.1916 Appendix - Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

p.1917 Appendix - VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

p.1918 Appendix - SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1919 Appendix - Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. p.1932 Appendix - Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

p.1933 Appendix - VFS Hyderabad to Chennai + the CSP portal

p.1934 Appendix - SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1935 Appendix - Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). p.1937 Appendix - Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

p.1948 Appendix - Taxes: minijob and Werkstudent

p.1950 Appendix - SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1951 Appendix - Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. p.1953 Appendix - Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

Bachelor/Master applications with APS go via VFS Chennai per the table (some sub-types via Hyderabad - follow your CSP letter; the wrong mission means deletion). Fee 75 / 37.50 + VFS about 1933 + 1326 + 690 + 115. Waiting time 8-12 weeks (Chennai 9-12, peak 13-15). CSP portal digital.diplo.de: apply online, pass the pre-check, get the biometrics link (group applications since Nov 25). Bring 2x A4 sets + originals: passport (10 years, 2 blank pages, 12 months validity), APS, admission letter (language noted), blocked account / sponsor / scholarship, class 10/12/semester marks, CV, motivation letter, language proof (IELTS 6.0-6.5 / TOEFL 80+ or TestDaF/DSH/C1 under 1 year), 90-day 30k travel insurance, fee. Start 6-8 months early. Appeals were abolished 01.07.25.

p.1966 Appendix - SOP + CV + LOR + interview + Anmeldung

SOP 500-800 words, 1-2 pages: introduction (who + which Kolleg/program + hook: MPC percent + B1 to Aero) + academic fit (MPC marks, drone/rocket project, Python/MATLAB/CAD, TestAS Engineering) + why this Kolleg/uni (2-3 modules + a lab from the module handbook) + honest no-JEE line (no Advanced rank, so T-Kurs + FSP is the recognised path; never criticise India; do not lead with free tuition) + future (FSP to named Bachelor + labs / 8-week TUM internship) + signature. CV: tabular, 1-2 pages, reverse chronological, no gaps, identical spellings. Two LORs from Maths/Physics lecturers on letterhead, 400-600 words, your rank + 2 examples + T-Kurs fitness. Interview 5-15 min: be genuine, know your city/fee/housing/duration (Kolleg 2 sem + Bachelor 6 sem), know your sponsor and the 992 payout, document every gap month (Goethe + TestAS + APS; fakes = ban). After arrival: landlord confirmation, Anmeldung within 14 days (section 17 BMG), bank account, enrolment, residence permit about 100 euros (eAT card, plus Fiktion if it expires).

p.1967 Appendix - Scholarships + work + Blue Card + PR + employers

EPOS (DAC incl. India, 4-year Bachelor + 2-year experience, max 15 months in DE, apply direct with 3 priorities Aug-Nov, 992 Master / 1300 PhD + travel + 460 + insurance + rent). WISE (IIT/NIT 5th/6th sem, find the professor yourself, public institutes only, 2-3 months May-Aug about 692-750 + 1200). Deutschlandstipendium 300/month (150 + 150, all nationalities, no income test, TUM about 800/year, TU Berlin 123). Erasmus Mundus 1400/month for 24 months + tuition (101 Indians in 2025). Boll 992 + 10k, KAS 992 + B2 (deadline 15.07). Work: new rule 140 full / 280 half days per year (was 120/240); HiWi and compulsory internships unlimited; 20 hours = 2.5 days. Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.1968 Appendix - APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.

p.1969 Appendix - Studienkolleg T/TI + entrance exam + FSP

T-Kurs (for university engineering) / TI-Kurs (for applied-sciences IT): German, Maths, Physics, Chemistry/IT, 32 hours per week, 2 semesters, about 25 per class, attendance compulsory. Entrance exam: onSET German (8 gap texts x 20 blanks, 40 minutes) + 1-hour digital Maths up to German class-11 level, no integrals (KIT ILIAS). Final FSP exam: German 4.5 hours (250-word graph essay + listening + reading + grammar: passive, modal, nominalisation, participles, subjunctive) + Maths 180 min (non-programmable calculator + Merziger/Wirth formula sheet) + Physics/Chemistry/IT 180 min + oral exam 20 min prep + 15 min exam. Deadlines 15.07 / 15.01. Public Kollegs cost 0 + about 300 contribution.

p.1970 Appendix - German + TestAS + IELTS in Hyderabad

Goethe-Zentrum Hyderabad, Banjara Hills (20 Journalists Colony Rd 3): Rs 27,730 per level for A1/A2/B1, B2 split in two parts, C1 via the office. Exams: A1 9400 / A2 10600 / B1 18800 / B2 21200 / C1 24000. TestDaF EUR 195 (no fixed Hyderabad slot, travel to Chennai/Bengaluru/Delhi/Pune). telc exams via German Drishty Hyderabad. A degree needs C1 (TestDaF 4x4 / DSH-2 / Goethe C1 / telc C1 Hochschule). Kolleg application needs B1 on paper, realistically B2. TestAS Core + Engineering module (24.10.26 / 26.11.26 / 25.02.27), target score 110+ (115+ for TUM/RWTH). IELTS at IDP Begumpet/Kukatpally Rs 17k/19k, centre-based only; Duolingo, PTE, Home Edition and MOI letters are rejected for the visa (india.diplo.de).

Blue Card 2025: 48,300 / 43,759.80, rising 2026 to 50,700 / 45,934.20 (BMI section 18g, federal gazette). MINT counts as shortage. Settlement with Blue Card after 21 months with B1 / 27 with A1 (was 33). Citizenship after 5 years (was 8) + B1; the 3-year fast track faces abolition. Dual citizenship is now the principle, but India forbids dual, so OCI. Employers: Airbus Hamburg/Bremen/Manching/Donauwoerth/Ottobrunn (513 jobs, apply 3-6 months early, AGGP graduate program), MTU Munich/Hannover, DLR 30+ institutes (4 weeks-6 months, HiWi, REXUS), ESA-ESOC staff only for ESA citizens (Indians via contractors/DLR), Isar Aerospace Ottobrunn English-first NewSpace (visa possible), Lilium insolvent - do NOT rely on it, Volocopter near zero, OHB 200+ (13 working students + 11 interns), Diehl 500+. Working-student pay 15-18 per hour, B1-B2 + CATIA/MATLAB/Python. Security clearance: EU/NATO citizenship often mandatory for classified/ITAR work (Eurofighter/A400M/FCAS), so Indians start in civil programs.

p.2000 Appendix - APS + Anabin + the 70% rule

APS Rs 18,000 via aps-india.de (pay by CCAvenue, courier to Delhi DLTA R.K. Khanna 110029, takes 3-10 weeks, never rename the DigZert PDF). TSBIE = 1000 points (Year 1: 500 + Year 2: 500); 700/1000 = the 70% floor from WS26/27 for Kolleg + 1-year bridge. Below that, only a full B.Tech followed by a Master. Check Anabin H+ status (anabin.kmk.org). Good hosts: JNTUH / OU / NITW. Your name must match your passport exactly. You need the Long Memo + Pass Certificate + TC; the short internet memo alone is not enough.
